page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-144-lssd is a high-capacity compute instance featuring 144 vCPUs mapped to 72 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor running at 2.3 GHz. The architecture is x86_64 with dedicated CPU allocation and hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 540 GB of system memory, providing 3.75 GB per core, and features a 504 MB L3 cache. Local storage is bundled with 24 local NVMe SSDs totaling 9383 GB. No graphics processing units are included in this configuration.

In benchmark evaluations, this server exhibits top-tier multi-core performance, achieving high scores in stress-ng multi-core CPU tests and PassMark CPU suites, including extended instructions, encryption, and physics. Memory bandwidth is high, reaching 11520.24 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 534.35 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. It also delivers top-tier performance in database operations, handling 207.97 million Redis SET operations per second, and static web serving throughput at 209.68 GB/sec. Single-core performance is moderate, placing in the average tier for stress-ng single-core tests.

Given its dense hardware profile of 144 dedicated vCPUs and nearly 9.4 TB of local NVMe SSD storage, this instance offers high resource density for compute-intensive and storage-heavy workloads. The primary tradeoff is the moderate single-threaded performance compared to its top-tier multi-core capabilities. This server is highly suited for large-scale database operations, high-throughput web serving, software compilation, and multi-threaded data processing tasks such as compression and LLM prompt processing.
